'''Foothold Citadel''' was an [[Alliance]] [[barracks]] within [[Theramore Isle]]. It was the headquarters of the [[Theramore Guard]], and the location of some military personnel as well as several vendors.

==History==
[[Daelin Proudmoore]] died in battle in this keep when [[Thrall]]'s forces stormed Theramore, led by [[Rexxar]] and his friends.
